title: Coda Desktop Electron UI
description: Create a complete Electron desktop UI for coda similar to semio desktop. Must visualize project, runs, iterations, reports, breachs, measures, targets, platforms and allow invoking coda tools (start_run, start_iteration, translate, validate, fix). Uses React, Tailwind, Electron Forge + Vite like semio desktop.
summary: Created complete Electron desktop UI for coda (ACC design assistant) mirroring semio desktop architecture. Built with Electron Forge + Vite + React + Tailwind CSS 4. Features 6 pages: Dashboard (stat cards, compliance overview), Config (measures, targets with properties/rules/clauses, platforms), Runs (run details, iterations), Report (violations with expandable clauses), Translations (per-target JSON), Actions (start run, start iteration, translate/validate per target, fix design with prompt, action log). Frameless window, collapsible sidebar, compliance badges, dark mode support. Communicates via streamable-http JSON-RPC. Deleted superseded CodaApp.tsx. Fixed workspace path.
